task: Judge a supplied claim against the incident explicitly selected by the analyst in a publisher-written report. No automatic date inference.
dataset: Six unchanged gh-april-2023 claims and assistant-reviewed references from completed publisher-report study. Inspected-case development diagnostic; not new held-out evaluation.

selection_contract.required: One exact incident-section header from the report inventory. No default, date inference, claim-to-section inference or fallback.
selection_contract.invalid: Missing, unknown or multiple selections require clarification before any call.
selection_contract.cross_incident: A claim deliberately comparing incidents is outside this one-incident contract and needs a separate task.
selection_contract.fixture_attribution: The assistant supplies the six prepared selections. Zero actual analyst entries, human or independent reviews.

arms.full: Fresh calls with byte-identical original full-report request.
arms.selected_full: Original full report plus selected_incident field; all question text unchanged.
arms.selected_section: Report-wide introduction plus complete explicitly selected incident section and the same selected_incident field; all question text unchanged.

comparators: full and selected_full cannot substitute after outcomes. Original literal rules are an offline comparator per arm, never a semantic ground truth.
failure_policy: Stop globally on checkpoint/context/envelope/HTTP/network failures. Retain invalid fields, withhold and keep all six claims per arm per round. No retries, repair or omitted failures.
success_boundary: Every declared criterion in every round, complete evidence and preserved references. Passing supports a new-incident confirmation plan only, not operational promotion.
preservation: Freeze producer source hashes, selection inventory, retained block hashes, exact request hashes, claim/reference dependencies and offline rule projections in a separately committed protocol before 54 calls. No old producer changes.
publication: Publisher snapshots and full-text requests stay ignored local. Public bundle contains original answer/usage payloads, hashes and summaries. Public replay uses frozen literal-rule projections; source/wire reconstruction requires matching local snapshots.
protected_telemetry: No new telemetry recording or protected allocation may open.
